title: Volume: the space inside
sentences: A prism stacks an unchanged base through a perpendicular height, giving V = Bh.
A pyramid or cone with the same base and height has one third of the corresponding prism or cylinder's volume.
Use matching units for all dimensions before multiplying.
Find the volume of a cylinder with radius 3 cm and height 5 cm.
spoken: A prism stacks an unchanged base through a perpendicular height, giving V equals Bh.
A pyramid or cone with the same base and height has one third of the corresponding prism or cylinder's volume.
Use matching units for all dimensions before multiplying.
Find the volume of a cylinder with radius 3 centimeters and height 5 centimeters.
B equals pi times 3 squared equals 9 pi square centimeters.
V equals B times h equals 9 pi times 5 equals 45 pi cubic centimeters.
45 times 3.1416 equals 141.372 cubic centimeters, or about 141.37 cubic centimeters.
